cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS nonnull,SUM(v) AS total,AVG(v) AS mean,COUNT_IF(p) AS kept,COUNT(DISTINCT v) AS unique_values,SUM(DISTINCT v) AS unique_total,AVG(DISTINCT v) AS unique_mean FROM samples

SELECT g,COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS nonnull,SUM(v) AS total,AVG(v) AS mean,COUNT_IF(p) AS kept,COUNT(DISTINCT v) AS unique_values,SUM(DISTINCT v) AS unique_total,AVG(DISTINCT v) AS unique_mean FROM samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS nonnull,SUM(v) AS total,AVG(v) AS mean,COUNT_IF(p) AS kept,COUNT(DISTINCT v) AS unique_values,SUM(DISTINCT v) AS unique_total,AVG(DISTINCT v) AS unique_mean FROM empty_samples

SELECT g,COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS nonnull,SUM(v) AS total,AVG(v) AS mean,COUNT_IF(p) AS kept,COUNT(DISTINCT v) AS unique_values,SUM(DISTINCT v) AS unique_total,AVG(DISTINCT v) AS unique_mean FROM empty_samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS nonnull,SUM(v) AS total,AVG(v) AS mean,COUNT_IF(p) AS kept,COUNT(DISTINCT v) AS unique_values,SUM(DISTINCT v) AS unique_total,AVG(DISTINCT v) AS unique_mean FROM samples WHERE g=1

SELECT g,COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS nonnull,SUM(v) AS total,AVG(v) AS mean,COUNT_IF(p) AS kept,COUNT(DISTINCT v) AS unique_values,SUM(DISTINCT v) AS unique_total,AVG(DISTINCT v) AS unique_mean FROM samples WHERE g=1 GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE p) AS n,COUNT(v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS nonnull,SUM(v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS total,AVG(v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS mean,COUNT_IF(p) FILTER(WHERE v IS NULL) AS kept,COUNT(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS unique_values,SUM(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS unique_total,AVG(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS unique_mean,COUNT_IF(DISTINCT p) AS unique_kept FROM samples

SELECT g,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE p) AS n,COUNT(v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS nonnull,SUM(v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS total,AVG(v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS mean,COUNT_IF(p) FILTER(WHERE v IS NULL) AS kept,COUNT(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS unique_values,SUM(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS unique_total,AVG(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS unique_mean,COUNT_IF(DISTINCT p) AS unique_kept FROM samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST
SELECT g,COUNT(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS n,SUM(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS total FROM samples GROUP BY g HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p)>0 ORDER BY total DESC,g NULLS FIRST
SELECT g,COUNT(v) AS n FROM samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY SUM(v) DESC NULLS LAST,g NULLS FIRST

SELECT g,h,GROUPING(g) AS gg,GROUPING(h) AS gh,GROUPING_ID(g,h) AS gid,COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS nonnull,SUM(v) AS total,COUNT(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS unique_kept FROM samples GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((g,h),(g),(h),())

SELECT g,h,GROUPING(g) AS gg,GROUPING(h) AS gh,GROUPING_ID(g,h) AS gid,COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS nonnull,SUM(v) AS total,COUNT(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS unique_kept FROM samples GROUP BY ROLLUP(g,h)

SELECT g,h,GROUPING(g) AS gg,GROUPING(h) AS gh,GROUPING_ID(g,h) AS gid,COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS nonnull,SUM(v) AS total,COUNT(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS unique_kept FROM samples GROUP BY CUBE(g,h)

SELECT g,h,GROUPING(g) AS gg,GROUPING(h) AS gh,GROUPING_ID(g,h) AS gid,COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS nonnull,SUM(v) AS total,COUNT(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE p) AS unique_kept FROM samples GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((g,h),(g),(g,h),(),(h),())

SELECT id,g,k,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k,id) AS row_number,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k) AS rank,LAG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k,id) AS previous,LEAD(v,2,-99) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k,id) AS next,LAG(v,2,CAST(NULL AS INT)) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k,id) AS previous_two FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,k,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS n,COUNT(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS nonnull,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS total,AVG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS mean FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,g,k,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC,id) AS row_number,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC) AS rank,LAG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC,id) AS previous,LEAD(v,2,-99) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC,id) AS next,LAG(v,2,CAST(NULL AS INT)) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC,id) AS previous_two FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,k,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS n,COUNT(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS nonnull,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS total,AVG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS mean FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,g,k,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS FIRST,id) AS row_number,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS FIRST) AS rank,LAG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS FIRST,id) AS previous,LEAD(v,2,-99) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS FIRST,id) AS next,LAG(v,2,CAST(NULL AS INT)) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS FIRST,id) AS previous_two FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,k,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS FIRST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS n,COUNT(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS FIRST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS nonnull,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS FIRST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS total,AVG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS FIRST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS mean FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,g,k,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS LAST,id) AS row_number,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS LAST) AS rank,LAG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS LAST,id) AS previous,LEAD(v,2,-99) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS LAST,id) AS next,LAG(v,2,CAST(NULL AS INT)) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS LAST,id) AS previous_two FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,k,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS n,COUNT(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS nonnull,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS total,AVG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k ASC NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS mean FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,g,k,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS FIRST,id) AS row_number,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS FIRST) AS rank,LAG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS FIRST,id) AS previous,LEAD(v,2,-99) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS FIRST,id) AS next,LAG(v,2,CAST(NULL AS INT)) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS FIRST,id) AS previous_two FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,k,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS FIRST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS n,COUNT(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS FIRST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS nonnull,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS FIRST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS total,AVG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS FIRST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS mean FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,g,k,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST,id) AS row_number,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank,LAG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST,id) AS previous,LEAD(v,2,-99) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST,id) AS next,LAG(v,2,CAST(NULL AS INT)) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST,id) AS previous_two FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,k,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS n,COUNT(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS nonnull,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS total,AVG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS mean FROM samples ORDER BY id
SELECT id,LAG(v,1,-99) IGNORE NULLS OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id) AS previous,LEAD(v,2,-99) IGNORE NULLS OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id) AS next FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,LAG(v,1,-99) RESPECT NULLS OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id) AS previous,LEAD(v,2,-99) RESPECT NULLS OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id) AS next FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS n,COUNT(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS nonnull,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS total,AVG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS mean FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n,COUNT(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS nonnull,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total,AVG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS mean FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS n,COUNT(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS nonnull,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS total,AVG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS mean FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS n,COUNT(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS nonnull,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS total,AVG(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS LAST,id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS mean FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,FIRST_VALUE(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_value,LAST_VALUE(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_value,FIRST_VALUE(v) IGNORE NULLS OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_nonnull,LAST_VALUE(v) IGNORE NULLS OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_nonnull,NTH_VALUE(v,2) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_value,NTH_VALUE(v,2) IGNORE NULLS OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_nonnull FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,FIRST_VALUE(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS first_value,LAST_VALUE(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS last_value,FIRST_VALUE(v) IGNORE NULLS OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS first_nonnull,LAST_VALUE(v) IGNORE NULLS OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS last_nonnull,NTH_VALUE(v,2) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS second_value,NTH_VALUE(v,2) IGNORE NULLS OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS second_nonnull FROM samples ORDER BY id
SELECT id,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW) AS peers,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k) AS running FROM samples ORDER BY id

SELECT id,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS n,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS total FROM samples ORDER BY id
SELECT SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(v)) AS values,SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(v)) AS unique_values,SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(v) FILTER(WHERE p)) AS kept FROM samples
SELECT g,SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(v)) AS values,SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(v)) AS unique_values,SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(v) FILTER(WHERE p)) AS kept FROM samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST
SELECT * FROM (SELECT g,v FROM samples) PIVOT(SUM(v) FOR g IN(0 AS zero,1 AS one,2 AS two))
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT_IF(p) AS kept,COUNT_IF(DISTINCT p) AS unique_kept FROM samples WHERE p IS NULL
SELECT g,COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT_IF(p) AS kept,COUNT_IF(DISTINCT p) AS unique_kept FROM samples WHERE p IS NULL GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST
